name: Website Builder
intro: Website Builder in SmartVideo lets you describe a website in plain language and have an AI agent write it, preview it live, and publish it. Here's a quick look around.

features.dashboard-and-projects: The dashboard lists your projects. Use the search box to find one, and the sort menu to switch between recent and starred, so you can reopen earlier sites quickly.
features.prompt-box: This is the prompt box, where every project starts. Describe your website idea, attach files if you like, set the agent thinking level, choose a model, then send.
features.model-and-provider-keys: In Settings, the Providers section is where you set up the AI providers behind the builder. The model you pick in the prompt box comes from the providers you have set up.
features.live-preview-and-iteration: Your site appears as a live preview right in the browser. Keep chatting with the agent to change layout, text, colors and features, and see each change straight away.
features.deploy: The Deploy button opens a dialog and publishes your site to a public address. After it deploys, the same button opens your live site.
features.download-code: You can download your generated code as a ZIP at any time. It's a simple way to keep your own copy or host the site somewhere else.
features.publish-to-community: Publish to Community opens a dialog where you add a short description and share your project in the community gallery for others to see.

outro: That's Website Builder. Write a clear first prompt with sections, tone and colors, preview carefully, and publish when it looks right.
